draft_id.description: A working draft to simulate. Provide one of draft_id / flow_id / graph (draft_id wins).

flow_id.description: A saved flow to simulate. Provide one of draft_id / flow_id / graph.

graph.description: An inline tinyflows WorkflowGraph to simulate: { nodes: [...], edges: [...] }. Provide one of draft_id / flow_id / graph.

input.description: Optional trigger input passed to the run (defaults to {}).
